experiment_metadata.architecture: QORIN-500M (20 layers, d_model=1536, 24 query / 4 KV heads, context 2048)
experiment_metadata.hardware_duty_cycle_policy: Maximum 105 minutes active compute, 15 minutes mandatory cooldown

branch_a.purpose: Provide the immutable reference standard on the 150-task generalization suite.

branch_b.early_stopping_condition: Halt if val_loss fails to improve for 3 consecutive evals (75 steps) or diverges by >10%
branch_b.purpose: Isolate the effect of contrastive dyads on Stage 1 decision boundary calibration without altering Stage 2 synthesis weights.

branch_c.training_corpus: Corpus 2 Train Split (SYN_FACT_*, SYN_CONFLICT, SYN_INSUFFICIENT, SYN_*)
branch_c.early_stopping_condition: Halt if val_loss fails to improve for 3 consecutive evals (75 steps) or diverges by >10%
branch_c.purpose: Isolate the effect of Structured Evidence Records on Stage 2 factual extraction and attribution without altering Stage 1 logits.

branch_d.training_corpus: Joint Train Pool (Corpus 1 Train [400] + Corpus 2 Train [400])
branch_d.early_stopping_condition: Halt if val_loss fails to improve for 3 consecutive evals (75 steps) or diverges by >10%
branch_d.purpose: Evaluate simultaneous optimization of tool decision calibration and grounded evidence synthesis. Controlled for epoch count (2.0 epochs across all branches).

branch_d_matched_updates.branch_name: Combined Intervention with Matched Optimizer Updates (Ablation Control)
branch_d_matched_updates.intervention_type: Joint Factorial Intervention with Update Normalization
branch_d_matched_updates.early_stopping_condition: Halt if val_loss fails to improve for 3 consecutive evals
branch_d_matched_updates.purpose: Strict ablation check: evaluates Branch D with exactly 200 optimizer updates to prove gains are attributable to curriculum synergy rather than update volume.

comparative_attribution_controls.exposure_control_mechanism: Dual-control: Primary Branch D is matched on Epoch Count (2.0 epochs, 400 updates); Ablation Branch D_matched is matched on Optimizer Updates (200 updates, 1.0 epoch).
comparative_attribution_controls.catastrophic_forgetting_safeguard: Cosine learning rate schedule decaying to 1.5e-6 with maximum gradient clipping of 1.0.
comparative_attribution_controls.isolation_guarantee: No test split data is accessible during any training branch.
